findings.failure_path: CommonMark ends an unclosed fence when its containing list item ends. The parser stays in fence mode after a dedent and skips the next root-level rule. Deleting that rule can therefore produce zero derived rows and leave the preservation gate green. The list-nested test always supplies an explicit closer.
findings.smallest_fix: Track the fence's containing list item. End the fence and reprocess the first line outside that item. Add a before/after regression that deletes the first root-level obligation after the list ends.

findings.failure_path: Changing HOME leaves an exported XDG_CONFIG_HOME active. Git can load the caller's global configuration during fixture setup. A global attributes file with a configured clean filter can alter the fixture blobs or fail git add before the revision check runs.
findings.smallest_fix: Set both HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME to fixture-owned directories for setup and the Python revision probe. Add a test with caller XDG Git configuration that would otherwise interfere with fixture setup.
